backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a todo list with functions to add, remove, toggle, update, and retrieve tasks stored in a List, with migration support and duplicate prevention.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts task storage from Map-based to List-based structure by transferring all tasks from the old actor format to the new one.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two high-confidence features: debugging task addition in TodoInput and verifying task persistence/loading in TodoList.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files describing React components, hooks, styling, and configuration for a todo app with dark mode and passive-aggressive modals.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes using warm earth tones without blue or purple.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with inline script to apply dark mode class before React loads to prevent flash of unstyled content.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component rendering the todo interface with header, dark mode toggle, input section, task list, and footer with attribution link.
frontend/src/components/DarkModeToggle.t: Toggle button component for switching between light and dark modes with localStorage persistence and sun/moon icons.
frontend/src/components/PassiveAggressiv: Dialog modal displaying randomly selected passive-aggressive messages for three variants: unchecking tasks, deleting unchecked tasks, and instant check-offs.
frontend/src/components/TodoInput.tsx: Input form component for adding new tasks using async/await with error handling, task timestamp recording, and input clearing on success.
frontend/src/components/TodoList.tsx: Task list component with checkboxes, inline editing, delete buttons, passive-aggressive modals triggered by user behavior, and async backend operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with identity-based authentication and automatic query invalidation on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for task CRUD operations (getAllTasks, addTask, toggleTask, updateTaskText, removeTask) that interact with the backend actor and invalidate cache on mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useTaskTimestamps.ts: Zustand store that tracks task creation timestamps to detect if a task was checked within 5 seconds of creation (instant check detection).
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-tone color palette for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom colors (using OKLCH), typography, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features, known issues (add task broken, no persistence), and requirements for a passive-aggressive todo list app with dark mode and edit capabilities.
